notes.title: Retro October 16, 2021 Update
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

I made a couple of changes to Retro recently, here it is!

[b]Difficulty changes[/b]
[list]
[*] Helicopters in Dogfight now have less health
[*] Decreased the point requirement to progress from Ball Protectors in story mode to 100
[/list]

[b]Gameplay changes[/b]
[list]
[*] If two bullets collide in Dogfight, they will both be destroyed
[/list]

[b]Bugfixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where a distortion effect wasn't applied in the intro of the story
[*] Fixed an issue where the player won't be told when they can progress during the "corruption" portion of the story
[/list]

[b]And a lot of optimization updates[/b]
I went through nearly all of the code in the game and revised it to be a bit more performance-friendly.

[b]Thanks[/b]
Thanks for playing Retro! I'll talk to everyone later! 

-Matthew

I've been working on my next game! You can follow my progress on [url=https://twitter.com/Matt_Bman]Twitter[/url].

notes.title: The music update has finally arrived!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone, it's Matthew.

[b]Music Update history[/b]
Back in September of 2020, I promised an update for all of the music in Retro. The main menu music was replaced when I announced it and I was working on replacing or updating some music. For the time being, I temporarily replaced some music with the songs I was more proud of. 

Fast forward to April of 2021, I canceled the music update. I've been busy with school, work, and working on my next game so I just didn't have the time to work on Retro. 

Recently, I revived the music update and here it is! To kick off the update, Retro will be 80% off for 2 weeks (starting tomorrow, Steam wouldn't let me start it today for some reason)!

[b]Changes in this update:[/b]
[list]
[*] 2 new songs: Hired Guns and Carbon. These are used for Zombies and Ball Protectors.
[*] All arcade songs have been updated.
[*] The soundtrack has been updated with these new songs.
[*] Fixed a bug that allowed objects to appear before the player was supposed to be able to see them.
[*] Minor optimization improvements.
[/list]

[b]Come talk to me![/b]
If you run into any bugs, want to ask me questions, or just want to chat, please email me at matthewbridgemangames@gmail.com or shoot me a DM on [url=https://twitter.com/Matt_Bman]Twitter[/url]! I'd be more than happy to chat!

[b]Love yourself[/b]
These past couple of years have been rough for everyone. I know it's super easy to feel bad right now and be upset with the general state of the world. I just want to say that I'm super proud of each and every one of you for persevering through this time. I really hope you are in a good mental state as it is extremely important to stay positive in a time like this. But most importantly: love yourself, even if you don't feel like loving yourself. If that's hard for you, please reach out to someone who can help. I really want everyone to be happy so don't be afraid to ask for help.

[b]Thank you and talk to you later![/b]
I can't thank everyone who has played Retro enough. You all really mean so much to me and I am so thankful for all of you. I really hope you have a fantastic day and I'll talk to everyone again when I release the settings update!
-Matthew

P.S. I've been working hard on my next game. You can see more about it and check out my progress on [url=https://twitter.com/Matt_Bman]Twitter[/url].

notes.title: Retro April 26, 2021 Update and Announcement
notes.notes:
Hey everyone! It's been a while. I've been busy working on my next game ([url=https://twitter.com/Matt_Bman]you can check out my progress on my Twitter[/url]). 

I got word about some bugs in the game, so I took some time and fixed them. 

If you run into any more bugs, please email me at matthewbridgemangames@gmail.com and I will get on it as soon as I can! Please tell me what the bug does and how it can be recreated so I can fix it. You can also email me about anything else, I'd love to chat!

I can't believe it has already been over a year since I released Retro! It feels like I just released it last week. Since the launch, I've been busy working on a couple of different game ideas. I've worked on about six different game idea and gotten to a playable version for a couple of them. However, I lost interest in each of them but I think the project I've been working on for a couple of months now is something really unique and I'm pretty confident I will finish it! So, keep an eye out for that!

Because I'm already busy with my other game and other stuff, I'm not sure I will be able to get the music update finished any time soon, if at all. I do want to get it finished but don't get your hopes up. Sorry again.

Now to the changes in this update:

[list]
[*] Fixed a bug that caused the boss fight to be unbeatable. Sorry to anyone who wasn't able to beat the game because of this.
[*] The player can no longer go off of the screen on the boss fight (I have no idea how this happened, but it's fixed now).
[*] Cleaned up some unnecessary objects in various mini-games.
[*] Minor optimization improvements.
[/list]

I hope you have a great day and I'll talk to everyone again soon!
-Matthew

notes.title: Retro August 23-28, 2020 update notes
notes.notes:
Arcade:
-Removed the requirement for players to reach a certain score to unlock the next game
-Increased the player fire rate for Dogfight

-Story:
-Decreased score requirements for each game:
[list]
[*] Unlocking Ball Protectors: 500 -> 400
[*] Unlocking Submariner: 300 -> 200
[*] Unlocking Sector Breach: 1000 -> 500
[*] Unlocking Dogfight: 800 -> 500

[*] Corrupted Zombies Story Trigger: 500 -> 400
[*] Corrupted Ball Protectors Story Trigger:: 300 -> 200
[*] Corrupted Submariner Story Trigger: 1000 -> 500
[*] Corrupted Sector Breach Story Trigger: 800 -> 500
[*] Corrupted Dogfight Story Trigger: 600 -> 300
[/list]

-Corrupted Arcade:
-Fixed an issue where the player isn't able to open some games from the corrupted arcade menu
-Fixed an issue where the corrupted arcade games wouldn't give the player a game over when they should
-Fixed an issue where in Sector Breach where the station would be white when damaged instead of red

-Achievements:
-Updated the images for the following achievements
[list]
[*]Unlock Corrupted Arcade
[*]Whoops...
[*]Uh oh...
[*]I should probably download an antivirus...
[/list] 
-Created 2 new achievements to accompany some recent changes

Other: 
-Added a lens distortion effect to make the game more like it's being played on an arcade cabinet

Bugfixes:
-Fixed an issue where the right row of turrets in ball protectors would be facing down instead of the center of the screen.

Reasoning:
-I believe that the score requirements for the arcade mode locked players out of finding a game they enjoyed if they couldn't meet the score requirement for the previous game.
-For the story mode, simply removing the score requirements would have a major impact on the story, so I decreased them because I felt they were too difficult to meet.
-The lens distortion looked cool 

Be expecting a music update (hopefully) really soon!

Have fun :)
-Matthew Bridgeman

notes.title: Retro June 7th update
notes.notes:
Hey everyone! Recently, I've been making a few changes behind the scenes for retro. You shouldn't notice much except for a small performance boost. Here are the (short) patch notes:

[list]
[*] Cleaned up some scripts to be better optimized and perform better.
[*] Update to how high scores are changed. (Shouldn't affect gameplay)
[*] The main menu now has announcements that will say certain things on certain days of the year. (e.g. Halloween or New Year's)
[*] The story has become better optimized.
[*] A lot of code has been condensed which should result in a smaller file size.
[*] Fixed the "missing executable" error.
[/list]

Have fun!

Expect a few more changes coming up soon.

notes.title: Retro has graduated from Early Access!
notes.notes:
Retro is now officially released and 40% off! Get it while it's on sale!

It's been a long and tiresome process working on Retro, but I've loved every minute of it and I hope everyone who plays it has as much fun playing it as I had making it!

If you run into any bugs or issues while playing, you can email me at [b]matthewbridgemangames@gmail.com[/b] and I'll get right to work on a fix! If Retro does well enough, I may even consider adding a new minigame or two!

Have fun everyone,
-Matthew Bridgeman
